snippet.title: Electronic shop simulator
snippet.description:
Hello everyone,
Electronic shop simulator is my first game developped solo and without any software knowledge used AI for all scripts. I hope you will like when you play my game. You can download and play demo by clicking this link 
https://cosarstudios.itch.io/electronic-shop-simulator

If you like my game you can add to your wish list or buy on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3711360/Electronic_shop_simulator/
